name: TorrentDownloads
note: Searches any word of the query ("Bethlehem Kudumba Unit" answered with fifty Law & Order episodes), so it is held to the name. Answers Cloudflare's addresses as of 2026-09-11, with a 521 now and then; on 2026-09-05 it did not. Carries Indian regional releases the other reachable indexes lack. Its seeder counts are invented, so they are not read: its own recorded page gives a 2013 Ubuntu 12.10 server ISO 978 seeders, and on 2026-09-14 it gave a 2014 film 7513 against 0 on five public trackers, three copies of it at the top of a search. Rows stay, without numbers, so they rank below anything measured.
